note: Five evaluator-authored executable hidden tests are frozen in this revision. Each drives the existing public tools/workflow.ts CLI (the seam the current public test suite already exercises) against a disposable fixture spike directory and was validated pre-freeze against the unimplemented baseline: dispatch-inspection-non-consuming, canonical-authority-adoption, and blocked-phase-retry currently FAIL for the exact reason the corresponding acceptance criteria name (spike.md Observed Failures #4, #5, and the AC35 blocked-retry gap); authority-status-evidence-aware-transitions currently FAILS for the exact reason spike.md Observed Failure #8 names; recoverable-preexecution-failure currently PASSES and is frozen as a non-regression control over the same dispatch code path. The remaining criteria rely on the implementation's own visible regression suite, bounded live-provider fixtures, real host-boundary execution, and static/provenance inspection, per the modes and evidence plans frozen in eval-spec.md and case-manifest.json, because the frozen Design Map deliberately leaves the execution-binding, delegation, role-result, retry-counter, and observability representations as implementation freedom that an evaluator-authored hidden test would otherwise have to invent.
